extClickToCall.copyRemedy: Select the number on the page and copy it by hand.
extClickToCall.title: Click to call
extClickToCall.sub: Rest the pointer on any phone number in Margince, or tab onto it, to call it, text it, open it in WhatsApp or Zalo, or copy it.
extClickToCall.international: WhatsApp and Zalo need the number with its country code, such as +84 for Vietnam.
